prompt_en: Core concept lock: 운동복 마법사. Treat every generated subject, action, lighting, and camera detail as support for this concept, not a replacement. Create a photojournalistic news photograph in the style of photojournalism. Subject and state: adult fitness creator wearing a discreet flesh-tone earpiece, covered track jacket, training pants, and sneakers; action and prop: driving out of a sprint start, a stopwatch and training band, a fingertip melting a single clear dot in frosted glass; make the pose, gaze, expression, hand placement, and immediate intention readable, with nearby props and background details supporting the action. Scene and location: on an indoor running track, a world where every trade skill is a school of magic; show clear spatial depth, environmental structure, foreground, midground, and background cues. Camera and composition: a full-frame mirrorless camera, medium close-up emphasizing expression, upper-body framing, a 70-200mm event telephoto zoom lens, sharp face-detection autofocus, a thin kinetic spell trail around the arm and stopwatch; define subject scale, frame edges, perspective, focus behavior, and any motion treatment clearly. Lighting: even gym overhead LED lighting, side light from camera right, high-speed strobe light, thin kinetic edge light trailing an athletic gesture; make shadow direction, highlights, reflected light, exposure balance, and atmosphere feel like a real photographic capture. Color and mood: soft pastel colors, focused; keep the palette, emotional tone, and world context coherent with the subject and setting. Photoreal surreal layer: surreal event: rain, wind, heat, or noise affecting everything except one protected spot; real-world anchor: a brass balance scale tipped mid-measure; physical realism cue: small objects leaning toward a magic source as gravity slants; make the impossible scene read as a real camera capture, not a collage or illustration, with clear scale cues, shadows, reflections, focus behavior, boundary occlusion, and consistent real-world lighting. Texture, format, and finish: a discreet flesh-tone earpiece, salt-crystal surface texture, covered track jacket, training pants, and sneakers, square 1:1 aspect ratio, real optical-photo realism without looking like digital collage; render skin, hair, fabric, metal, glass, makeup, and accessories with accurate material detail. Constraints: no text or watermark. Prioritize a specific, image-ready photographic result over a vague style summary. Additional requirements: sportswear identity should read through covered track jacket, training pants, sneakers, stopwatch or training band, and running-track or gym context; do not collapse the role into an archive scholar; keep the athletic read practical and nonsexualized; action may be poised, mid-start, or controlled, not body-first fitness glamour; wizard identity should be constructed as medium plus scale plus transformation plus cost or trace; the spell should visibly use the role's own tool, document, screen, seal, mirror, gift, stopwatch, or material surface rather than defaulting to a generic spell circle; unless the user explicitly asks for sci-fi, robot, android, cyborg, data-ghost, alien, or machine-interface magic, do not add visible tech visors, antenna headsets, sensor bands, status LED badges, maintenance QR wristbands, data-port collars, lidar scan dots, machine-vision camera views, robot diagnostics, lens-array focus, exposed-joint focus, boot-flicker motion, cable-fiber textures, liquid-metal textures, synthetic-skin textures, brushed-alloy robot textures, or AR hologram UI as the main spell evidence; distinct from stage magician: no playing-card fan, tailcoat, top hat, audience performance, or sleight-of-hand stagecraft should dominate the image; avoid routine glowing magic circles, generic blue aura, standard fantasy robes, and default old-book-and-candle staging unless the selected bundle explicitly asks for scholarly archive magic; the world response should be specific, local, and visible at thumbnail scale: refraction at a contact point, textless marks lifting above the surface, a few-centimeter levitation shadow, suspended dust or snow, a screen pulse, or a material boundary changing state while the role outfit stays readable; the active spell should visibly change matter or force in the photographed space, not only display symbols: paper chars, ink climbs uphill, frost grows, wax melts and resolidifies, thread tightens, salt vibrates, dust is displaced, crystals grow, candle flames bend, air ripples, or a real object levitates with a cast shadow; for role-wizard bundles, the magic evidence should be the second-strongest visual read after the role tool or costume; avoid relying only on tiny decorative glows, flat in-plane marks, or monochrome lighting when the spell depends on luminous detail; after the latest wizard image reviews, prefer the causal chain tool -> material response -> residue: a viewer should see what caused the spell, what changed physically, and what trace or cost remains; expand wizardry beyond glow or magic circles into practical craft, bureaucracy, scientific thaumaturgy, domestic warding, urban folk rituals, scale paradoxes, and aftermath/cost evidence; when the role is modern or ordinary, strengthen the physical proof rather than adding fantasy costume: wax cooling, paper charring, ink climbing, condensation forming, thread tightening, salt vibrating, dust displaced, frost growing, or air rippling; the covered sportswear stays readable through track jacket, training pants, sneakers, stopwatch, and running-track context, while timing and motion become the spell medium; wizardness should read as kinetic magic: the stopwatch face, training band, or arm gesture bends lane dust and the air around the motion trail, with a subtle gravity lean in nearby markers, not robes, spell circles, books, generic aura, AR UI, or visor. Inspired by the described styling and vibe; an original adult fictional person, not an exact likeness of any real individual.

피사체의 자세, 시선, 표정, 손동작, 즉각적인 동작 의도가 한눈에 읽히게 하고, 주변 소품과 배경 요소는 그 행동을 설명하도록 배치한다. 장면과 장소: 실내 육상 트랙에서, 손기술이 곧 주문인 세계; 공간의 깊이, 바닥/벽/하늘 또는 실내 구조, 전경/중경/후경의 거리감을 분명히 보여준다. 카메라와 구도: 풀프레임 미러리스 카메라, 인물의 표정을 살린 미디엄 클로즈업, 상반신 중심 프레이밍, 70-200mm 이벤트 망원 줌렌즈, 얼굴 인식 AF로 잡힌 선명한 초점, 팔과 스톱워치 주변에 남는 얇은 운동 주문 궤적; 피사체 크기, 프레임 가장자리, 원근감, 초점 위치, 움직임 처리를 명확히 한다. 조명: 헬스장 천장 LED의 균일한 빛, 오른쪽에서 들어오는 측면광, high-speed strobe light, 운동 동작의 가장자리에 남는 얇은 운동 궤적광; 그림자 방향, 하이라이트, 반사광, 노출 균형, 대기감을 실제 촬영처럼 보이게 한다. 색감과 분위기: 부드러운 파스텔 컬러, 집중한 분위기; 색 대비, 감정 톤, 세계관 맥락이 피사체와 장소에 맞아야 한다. 포토리얼 초현실 레이어: 초현실 사건은 한 사람이나 사물만 규칙에서 면제되는 사건; 현실 앵커는 황동 양팔 저울; 물리 단서는 중력 경사에 기울어진 물체들; 불가능한 장면이지만 합성이나 일러스트가 아니라 실제 카메라로 촬영된 순간처럼 보이게 하고, 스케일 단서, 그림자, 반사, 초점, 경계면 가림, 현실 조명의 일관성을 분명히 유지한다. 질감과 마감: 눈에 띄지 않는 이어피스, 소금 결정 표면, 트랙 재킷, 트레이닝 팬츠, 스니커즈의 커버드 운동복, 정사각형 1:1 비율, 합성처럼 보이지 않는 실제 광학 사진감; 피부, 머리카락, 천, 금속, 유리, 메이크업, 액세서리 같은 소재 단서를 실제 질감으로 표현한다. 제약: 텍스트와 워터마크 없음. 이미지 생성 시 요구사항을 빠뜨리지 말고, 막연한 스타일 요약보다 구체적인 사진 결과를 우선한다. 추가 요구사항: sportswear identity should read through covered track jacket, training pants, sneakers, stopwatch or training band, and running-track or gym context;
